title: Retail web banking session and account navigation
workflow: Authenticate with approved browser OIDC flow and validated redirect origin
Create protected session with institutional and customer scope
Load permitted accounts, balances and authorized actions from server
Show responsive navigation and transaction states without screen cramping
Require step-up for sensitive operations and revoke stale sessions
Terminate session safely and clear sensitive local caches
invariants: Never store reusable long-lived banking secrets in unprotected local storage
Session inactivity and lifetime limits are bank-policy defined
Account switch must revalidate mandate and institution boundary
Do not display cached balance as live when source unavailable
Responsive controls meet keyboard and screen reader requirements
Logout and token revocation prevent further privileged actions
acceptance_tests: Stolen stale session cannot initiate transaction
Session expiry clears sensitive screen state
Screen-reader order matches visual task flow
independent_gate: Approved authentication policy, accessibility standard selection and real browser/security test evidence.
